notes.title: Vortigon is back!
notes.content:
Some of you have had trouble getting Vortigon to unlock after completing all achievements, which should now be fixed. Lmk in the comments if you're still having issues. Other fixes in this build:

• Bug fix: When in fullscreen, the glass shatter effect is glitched when returning to main menu after losing a campaign match
• Bug fix: Muzzle flash on guns not showing
• Bug fix: Game over is sometimes triggered in survival mode when killing an opponent

notes.title: A couple of improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Windowed mode added![/b] You can now toggle between windowed/fullscreen in the settings menus for both games, or by clicking the icon in the bottom right corner of the home screen.
[*][b]Improved level/character sharing![/b] It now works like it did in the original game, where you copy and paste the codes into text boxes.
[/list]

notes.title: Chaos Faction Legacy Collection is Here!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection. This collection brings together the original Chaos Faction and Chaos Faction 2 in their classic formats, allowing players to relive the fast-paced, explosive arena combat that defined a generation of Flash games. Customize your character, select your weapons, and battle through a variety of creative and dangerous levels. Whether you're a veteran of the chaotic battles or a newcomer ready to experience the mayhem for the first time, this collection is the ultimate tribute to the legendary brawlers.

We’re throwing a knockout punch of gratitude to the fans who fought alongside us since the original games! Your unwavering support has been the ultimate power-up, helping us resurrect these classics for veterans and newcomers alike. Thanks for jumping back into the arena and keeping the chaos alive—this nostalgic brawl wouldn’t be the same without you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3038340/Chaos_Faction_Legacy_Collection/
